criteria.summary: A clossys.page/1 record: route path, frames.* frame, unique sections.* sections, Writer title key, <slot>#<key> copy.
Every display string on the page (label, title, prompt ...) is a Writer key, never inline text.
A clossys.publication/1 record: format, unique entry order, home route in it, derived source, tree of page slots.
A release manifest of one publication: every gate recorded pass, every pin with a sha256, a build named by its digest at its build path, a lineage (previous, diff, source) that agrees with itself.
